name: flambe
description: Track substantial work as a live Flambe call stack and coordinate scope through the Reducer Agent.

interface.longDescription: Flambé tracks substantial human and agent work as a live call stack instead of a flat task list. In ChatGPT, the plugin can inspect your Flambé traces, start meaningful activities, nest rabbit holes under their parent work, suspend and resume work, plan future activities, end completed activities with outcomes, and ask the Flambé Reducer Agent for scope guidance. The bundled skill tells ChatGPT when to use those tools so routine shell commands and file reads do not pollute the flame chart. Flambé requires a connected Flambé account and uses OAuth for the hosted MCP connection.
defaultPrompt: Track this substantial task in Flambé while you help me.
Show me my current Flambé activity stack.
Use Flambé naturally while you investigate this task.

positive.description: Creates a new root work activity after discovering the user's available Flambé trace.
positive.prompt: Start a new root Flambé activity called “Review public plugin”.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin discovers the authenticated user's trace if needed, then calls flambe_start with the selected trace, the requested name, a stable ChatGPT agent identity, platform ChatGPT, and parent_id null. It reports the created activity and follows any reducer direction or reply.

positive.description: Reads active work without mutating the user's trace.
positive.prompt: Show me my currently active Flambé work.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin discovers the trace if needed and calls flambe_status with active_only true. It summarizes only the returned active activities and does not create, end, suspend, or resume anything.

positive.prompt: Plan an unstarted Flambé activity called “Record plugin demo”.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin resolves the trace and calls flambe_plan with the requested name. With no requested schedule, it leaves scheduled_start and scheduled_end unset and reports the created unstarted activity.

positive.description: Uses nested lifecycle actions for a bounded subproblem and records its outcome.
positive.prompt: Under my current Flambé work, start a child activity called “Check OAuth redirect”, then end that child with the outcome “Verified the redirect flow”.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin resolves the current active activity, starts the requested child without flattening the parent, reuses the returned child id, then ends that child with the requested outcome message while leaving the parent open.

positive.description: Asks the Reducer Agent for guidance before widening scope.
positive.prompt: Tell the Flambé reducer that this task now needs a database migration and ask whether I should widen scope.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin resolves the active activity and sends a concise scope-change update with flambe_message. It reports the reducer assessment/reply and obeys any pause, stop, escalate, or other returned direction before doing additional work.

negative.description: Email is outside Flambé's capabilities and should not invoke Flambé tools.
negative.prompt: Send my teammate an email saying the build passed.

negative.description: Bulk deletion of all history is not exposed by the Flambé plugin tools.
negative.prompt: Delete all of my Flambé history and my account.

negative.description: An unrelated factual utility request should not invoke Flambé.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Denver today?

review.commerce_description: Flambé does not sell products or services, initiate purchases, or process payments through the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial public Flambé plugin release with the bundled call-stack skill, OAuth-authenticated MCP tools, trace discovery, lifecycle actions, planning, reducer messaging, and public-review metadata.
